text:
rachel: VividAI opened a billing dispute for INV-2026-6217. They show a $8,775.43 overage on Dedicated after an EU failover window on 2026-08-11.
diego: I pulled the raw meter stream and see repeated events from PulseMeter between 02:13:12Z and 02:22:55Z. Looks like a retry storm from their forwarder.
carla-finance: can you paste a short sample? need to size the hit for provisional credit.
pete-ops: sample (sanitized):

``
2026-08-11T02:13:12Z,VividAI,eu-west,PM-DED-BURST,5400
2026-08-11T02:13:12Z,VividAI,eu-west,PM-DED-BURST,5400
2026-08-11T02:14:45Z,VividAI,eu-west,PM-KV-HIT,12000
2026-08-11T02:14:45Z,VividAI,eu-west,PM-KV-HIT,12000
```

pete-ops: deduping by event_id removes the duplicates; net duplicated units ~186k token-equivalents across meters.
carla-finance: estimated cost at our Dedicated effective rates = $8,792. That's close to their invoice delta $8,775.43 (rounding/tax). I'll propose a provisional credit for the full $8,775.43 and mark it VendorRecovery/PulseMeter/PM-5581.
pulsemeter-support: ticket PM-5581 opened. We traced this to an internal queue retry loop that replayed batches. We accept responsibility and will issue a vendor credit note.
rachel: customer is asking for the credit to be posted this week to avoid internal chargebacks. Can we do provisional credit?
carla-finance: yes but need ops confirmation + at least one finance lead signoff. Also tag legal if >$10k. This is under $10k so proceed with standard vendor-recoverable flow.
pete-ops: ops confirm duplicates are from vendor side (identical event_ids). We'll attach hashed event_ids to the vendor ticket for accountability. Also adding a monitoring alert for event_id replay patterns.
carla-finance: accounting memo (provisional):

``
DR Revenue Adjustment 6102: $8,775.43
CR Accounts Receivable 1200: $8,775.43
```

carla-finance: @rachel please approve customer message. Keep it concise and say provisional credit pending vendor reimbursement.
rachel: draft: "Hi VividAI — we identified duplicated meter events originating from our metering vendor during your EU failover on 2026-08-11. We've issued a provisional credit of $8,775.43 to your account while we work with the vendor on reimbursement. We expect a final reconciliation within 14 business days. Apologies for the disruption."
carla-finance: fine. post it and attach reconciliation CSV. Also tag ticket PM-5581.
rachel: sent to customer and pasted permalink: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01FINANCE/p1854321000001234
carla-finance: approvals: @carla-finance (self), @pete-ops react with :thumbsup: to authorize posting provisional credit.
carla-finance: (reacts) :thumbsup:
pete-ops: (reacts) :thumbsup:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-6217 status updated -> ADJUSTED (credit $8,775.43) / VendorTicket: PM-5581
carla-finance: leaving thread open until vendor credit note posts and AR reconciliation completes. Action items: attach event_id hash list to PM-5581, monitor vendor ticket, confirm reimbursement within 14 days, post final GL reversal if reimbursed.
